company.name: PideDirecto
company.shortDescription: PideDirecto helps local businesses with own branded on-demand ordering and delivery solutions.
company.description:
PideDirecto is a digital ordering and delivery platform that enables any business to offer a branded on-demand delivery service to their own clients.

PideDirecto enables local businesses such as restaurants, pharmacies, local grocery stores, flower shops, clothing stores, cake shops, and many more by building out their own branded website, integrating phone and social media orders, and helping them deliver their products in less than 30 minutes. While also providing partners key customer insights and marketing support. 

All for a reasonable fixed monthly fee, without eating up margins with hefty commissions and service charges.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that finds and assigns available delivery couriers from integrated providers to fulfill orders efficiently.
productsAndServices.name: Logistics Orchestrator
